name: loop-animation
description: A Codex skill for turning concepts into continuous interactive Three.js explainers and exporting them as HTML, MP4, GIF, PNG, subtitles, or narration data.

scripts.qa:water: npm run build && node scripts/qa.mjs --demo water --width 1920 --height 1080
scripts.qa:water:strict: npm run build && node scripts/qa.mjs --demo water --width 1920 --height 1080 --fail-on-continuity
scripts.qa:water-v2: npm run build && node scripts/qa.mjs --demo water-v2 --width 1920 --height 1080
scripts.qa:water-v2:strict: npm run build && node scripts/qa.mjs --demo water-v2 --width 1920 --height 1080 --fail-on-continuity
scripts.qa:eclipse: npm run build && node scripts/qa.mjs --demo eclipse --width 1920 --height 1080
scripts.qa:eclipse:strict: npm run build && node scripts/qa.mjs --demo eclipse --width 1920 --height 1080 --fail-on-continuity
scripts.qa:continuity: npm run qa:water-v2:strict && npm run qa:eclipse:strict
scripts.export:mp4: npm run build && node scripts/export.mjs --format mp4
scripts.export:gif: npm run build && node scripts/export.mjs --format gif
scripts.export:png: npm run build && node scripts/export.mjs --format png
scripts.export:water:mp4: npm run build && node scripts/export.mjs --format mp4 --demo water --width 1920 --height 1080
scripts.export:water:gif: npm run build && node scripts/export.mjs --format gif --demo water --width 1200 --height 675 --fps 15
scripts.export:water-v2:mp4: npm run build && node scripts/export.mjs --format mp4 --demo water-v2 --width 1920 --height 1080
scripts.export:water-v2:gif: npm run build && node scripts/export.mjs --format gif --demo water-v2 --width 1200 --height 675 --fps 15 --start 8 --duration 10
scripts.export:water-v2:png: npm run build && node scripts/export.mjs --format png --demo water-v2 --time 16 --width 1920 --height 1080
scripts.story:water:zh: npm run build && node scripts/export-story.mjs --demo water --lang zh
scripts.story:water:en: npm run build && node scripts/export-story.mjs --demo water --lang en
scripts.story:water-v2:zh: npm run build && node scripts/export-story.mjs --demo water-v2 --lang zh
scripts.story:water-v2:en: npm run build && node scripts/export-story.mjs --demo water-v2 --lang en
scripts.story:eclipse:zh: npm run build && node scripts/export-story.mjs --demo eclipse --lang zh
scripts.story:eclipse:en: npm run build && node scripts/export-story.mjs --demo eclipse --lang en
scripts.story:all: npm run story:water-v2:zh && npm run story:water-v2:en && npm run story:eclipse:zh && npm run story:eclipse:en
